AUTHOR: Zhang
TITLE: MSGNet: multi-source guidance network for fish segmentation in underwater videos
REGION: Australia (DeepFish tropical Australia; Seagrass two estuaries, SE Queensland)
SPECIES: fish (binary fish/background); MoCA-Mask camouflaged animals incl. scorpionfish, flatfish
DATA: DeepFish segmentation subset (13 clips, 310 frames) + Luderick-Seagrass (18 clips, 4280 frames); MoCA-Mask (32 clips, 1539 frames) as additional dataset
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'The videos in the first two datasets suffer from severe water turbidity and insufficient lighting.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'We selected 31 video clips with 4409 images from the DeepFish dataset and Seagrass dataset at a ratio of 6:2:2 for training, validation, and testing.'
E_EV: Table 4: only 'mPA/% mIoU/%' segmentation metrics reported
ARCH: MSGNet dual-stream (ResNet-101 encoders, M-CAGM, FAFM) with RAFT optical flow and FCN preprocessing
NOTE: Split '31 video clips with 4409 images ... at a ratio of 6:2:2' - unclear whether clips or frames were split; D1=NR (lower-information choice). MoCA-Mask experiment retrains on its own 6:2:2 split, so not an external test of the fish model (R1=N). DeepFish/Seagrass provenance: DeepFish random per-habitat image split in original; here own split. Platform not stated in paper (DeepFish 'high-definition digital camera', Seagrass 'submerged action cameras'). Code on GitHub; datasets public.
AUTHORS_FULL: Zhang, P; Yu, H; Li, HQ; Zhang, X; Wei, SX; Tu, W; Yang, ZY; Wu, JF; Lin, YS
